name: empty-match
description: Recorded 2026-10-28, re-verifying a real behavior change in the vendor's v1.9.0 release: a zero-match search (closed_since pushed into 2099) now charges 0 credits and leaves the balance untouched (`billing.credits_charged: 0`, `_meta.credits_charged: 0`, `credits_remaining` unchanged at 20). Before this release the vendor billed a 1-credit floor even on an empty result; this connector's docs said so until this fixture replaced the assumption with a live recording. The empty-result shape also differs from a matched one: no `returned`/`limit`/`max_limit`, but `hint`, `filters_as_sent`, and the full `valid_stages`/`valid_industries` enums to help the caller retry. Verbatim, no trimming needed.
